bullets.title: META +5% premarket: Muse AI agent launch drives broad re-rating
bullets.body: Meta's Muse personal AI agent hit #4 on the App Store with usage 10x higher than internal testing cohorts, driving shares up ~5% premarket. Bulls see Muse addressing ROI concerns on AI investment and opening $30T consumer spend TAM; Mizuho notes the product is 'not yet priced in' at 18x 2028 EPS. Bear case: privacy/safety scrutiny and risk to GOOGL search/OTA models is real but manageable per JPM, who compares AI agent fears to prior OpenClaw freakout.

bullets.title: META Muse disruption fears hit SHOP -8%, BKNG -7%, DASH -5%, EXPE -8%
bullets.body: AI agent launch fears drove a broad selloff in gig/travel/commerce names. JPM analyst argues agents are designed to work WITH existing platforms (Shopify president highlighted merchant discoverability on Muse), comparing fears to prior AI agent scares. SHOP President and CEO publicly endorsed Muse integration, but stocks remain under pressure premarket.

bullets.title: FOXA/ROKU: DOJ issues Second Request, widening antitrust probe into $22B deal
bullets.body: DOJ staff plan to issue a formal 'second request' for additional data from Fox and Roku on their $22B merger ($160/sh: $96 cash + $64 stock), expected to close H1 2027. FOXA -1.4%, ROKU -0.9% premarket. JPM analyst expects deal ultimately clears despite probe; combined entity would be third-largest U.S. TV player by viewing share with ~$400M run-rate cost synergies.

bullets.title: AVGO reaffirms $115B FY27 / $230B FY28 AI revenue targets at Goldman Communacopia
bullets.body: Broadcom reaffirmed its $115B FY27 and $230B FY28 AI revenue targets at GS Communacopia, noting supply is the binding constraint. AVGO also announced a $35B XPV partnership to fund 20GW+ compute capacity. QCOM separately reaffirmed $15B FY29 datacenter revenue target with robotics upside; identified AMZN as a hyperscaler customer with a 10-year/$60B warrant deal, revenue beginning F1Q27.

bullets.title: NVDA: N3 demand to consume 55-60% of TSMC 2027 capacity; shortage worsens
bullets.body: JPM estimates NVDA's Rubin/Vera ramp will absorb 55-60% of total TSMC N3 wafers in 2027 vs. <10% in 1H26. Unfulfilled N3 demand estimated at ~600k wafers in 2026, widening further in 2027 despite TSMC adding ~40% N3 capacity. NVDA down yesterday while Tech Momentum surged +6.7%, marking the 12th instance in 2026 where >5% Tech Mo moved opposite to NVDA.

bullets.title: NBIS: AI compute demand visibility extending to 2028; Palantir partnership announced
bullets.body: Nebius at GS Communacopia described AI compute demand as 'far above supply' with customer requests extending into early 2028, lengthening their shortage view from ~18 to ~24+ months. Auction-based pricing tests showed 15-20% premiums above prior levels. New Palantir partnership strengthens enterprise distribution; NBIS +7.7% yesterday on OpenAI Astra tailwinds.

bullets.title: CRM: JPM Investor Day preview — Agentforce/Data360 ARR path to $5B+ by FY27 exit
bullets.body: JPM (OW, $265 PT) previews Dreamforce: expects CRM to reaffirm $63B+ FY30 revenue target and confirm Agentforce/Data360 ARR exceeding $5B exiting FY27 and $10B+ exiting FY30. Organic cRPO accelerated to ~10% in F2Q27. Valuation at ~11x EV/uFCF vs. 15x peer group; customers on Agentforce tracking toward 2x prior ACV with path to 3-4x as deployments scale.

bullets.title: AAPL: Foldable iPhone event today; $2K price point, Pro models up $100
bullets.body: Apple holds its product event today at 1pm ET, unveiling its first foldable iPhone priced at ~$2,000; iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max raised $100 vs. predecessors; lower-priced models deferred to spring 2027. Stock has historically underperformed on event days before recovering over the following month. New Apple Watch and AirPods also announced.

bullets.title: HOOD: Multiple initiations — StoneX Buy $170, Mizuho raises to $140 on AI IPO trading boom
bullets.body: StoneX initiates Robinhood at Buy with $170 PT (45% upside) and Mizuho upgrades to Outperform, raising PT from $130 to $140 on anticipated AI IPO retail trading volumes. SpaceX IPO drove ~24% M/M equity volume surge and ~1mn new funded customers in 2Q — the largest quarterly gain in nearly 5 years. 4Q26 equity volumes estimate raised to $1,074B (~50%+ Y/Y).

bullets.title: AFRM: Loop Capital initiates Buy at $105, 46% upside
bullets.body: Loop Capital Markets initiates Affirm at Buy with a $105 PT, implying 46% upside. GS Communacopia noted Affirm is scaling toward $100B annual GMV via multi-channel strategy. Loop also initiates SOFI at Hold ($22) and UPST at Hold ($34).

bullets.title: IONQ: Mizuho raises FY27E to $780M on SKYT integration; 256PQ deploys early 2027
bullets.body: Following the completed SkyWater acquisition, Mizuho raises IONQ FY27E/FY28E revenue to $780M/$1.17B (prior consensus $405M/$775M). SkyWater drives an 80% chip cycle reduction (9 to 2 months), 12x capacity scale, and 330x cost/qubit reduction. IonQ's 256PQ system deploys early 2027 with 99.99% 2Q fidelity. MS raises FY26 guidance to $450-460M with SkyWater contributing ~$170M.

bullets.title: ORCL/ADBE/RH: Earnings after close Thursday — consensus snapshots
bullets.body: Three names report Thursday after the bell: Oracle consensus EPS $1.74, revenue $19.13B; Adobe consensus EPS $6.08, revenue $6.69B; RH consensus EPS $0.38, revenue $915.4M. UBS notes ORCL +2.36% yesterday on OpenAI Astra-driven NeoClouds tailwind; ORCL was also removed from Hedgeye's 'OutBucket' in today's risk range signals.

bullets.title: ADI: Acquires Alif Semiconductor for $1.35B + up to $200M contingent; on-device AI play
bullets.body: Analog Devices announced an all-cash acquisition of Alif Semiconductor for $1.35B upfront plus up to $200M in contingent consideration, expected to close by end of 2026. Alif produces AI-native microcontrollers and fusion processors with heterogeneous architecture for real-time sensor fusion and on-device AI; silicon already shipping in production.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Bearish trend signal, data center delays, down -2.3% premarket
bullets.body: Hedgeye shifted GOOGL to Bearish trend (buy level $330, sell $347, prev close $338). Separately, Google/Blackstone data center venture hit permitting and site delays. Mizuho flags Muse as a risk to GOOGL core search; GS Communacopia noted GOOGL highlighted continued AI cloud strength with vertically integrated infrastructure, but sentiment remains negative.

bullets.title: NFLX: Hedgeye downgrades trend to Bearish
bullets.body: Hedgeye's Risk Range signals shifted NFLX from Bullish to Bearish trend today, with no specific earnings catalyst cited. AMZN also shifted from Bullish to Neutral. MSFT, AAPL, NVDA, META, and SNOW remain in Bullish trend.

bullets.title: FWONK: Jefferies initiates Buy at $115, 21% upside; sports rights cycle favorable for DIS/FOXA
bullets.body: Jefferies initiates Formula One/Liberty Media (FWONK) at Buy with $115 PT (21% upside from $94.95). Separately, JPM's Sports Rights Almanac flags DIS and FOXA as best positioned to defend marquee rights in the next cycle (NFL opt-outs post-2029, FIFA, MLB, NHL); WBD has the strongest operating profit-to-AAV ratio after losing NBA. Sports rights growing at 8% CAGR vs. 3% for the broader video ecosystem.

bullets.title: DASH: Scotiabank initiates Sector Outperform with $275 PT
bullets.body: Scotiabank initiated DoorDash at Sector Outperform with a $275 price target. The initiation comes as DASH faces near-term overhang from AI agent disruption fears (stock -5% yesterday on META Muse launch), which JPM views as overdone.

bullets.title: DLR: CEO signals double-digit FFOPS growth from retail portfolio + 1MW leasing + private capital
bullets.body: Citi's Communacopia takeaway from Digital Realty CEO Andy Power was positive: triple-threat growth strategy (retail-centric portfolio, 1MW leasing, expanding private capital) supports double-digit annual core FFOPS growth. Citi viewed commentary on demand 'positively.'

bullets.title: CPI today: JPM models Core +0.21% MoM; 63% market-implied probability of Sept 16 hike
bullets.body: JPM's Feroli forecasts Headline CPI +0.38% MoM and Core +0.21% MoM (2.4% Y/Y Core). Bond market pricing ~63% probability of a 25bp hike at the Sept 16 FOMC. Scenario analysis: Core 0.15-0.20% → SPX +1-1.5%; 0.20-0.25% → +50bp-1.25%; 0.25-0.30% → -25bp-1%; >0.30% → -1.5-2.5%. Options pricing ~1% move for Sept 11 expiry.

bullets.title: CHWY: Q2 beat, FY guidance raised; UBS stays Neutral on Q3 EBITDA miss vs. consensus
bullets.body: Chewy reported Q2 adj. EBITDA $226.7M vs. consensus $210.8M (+8%); 208k net customer adds; FY26 sales guidance raised to $13.46-13.57B and EBITDA margin to 6.7-6.8%. Q3 adj. EBITDA implied ~$222M vs. $226M consensus — the mild Q3 miss is the bear case. JPM maintains Overweight; UBS stays Neutral at $24 PT (~9x CY27 EBITDA), citing elevated fuel costs and measured consumer.
